description: List a channel's recent catalog in compact creator-analysis shape. Unfiltered calls scan maxResults uploads by default; filtered calls (includeShorts/includeLongForm/publishedWithinDays) scan min(500, max(50, maxResults*5)) uploads by default so filters still have enough candidates. Short/long/unknown format labels are evidence-aware: videos whose format cannot be resolved are labeled unknown and excluded when a filter keeps only Shorts or only long-form. [~3-10s]

refresh.description: Fetch fresh catalog data instead of reusing cached results (default false)

scanLimit.description: Override how many recent uploads are scanned before filtering and sorting (1-500, must be >= maxResults). Default: maxResults when unfiltered, min(500, max(50, maxResults*5)) when filtered.

name: listChannelCatalog
